architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management lib (use React context + hooks). API calls via fetch. Form handling with react-hook-form. File uploads via native FormData. Auth via JWT in httpOnly cookie. Ponytail: no SSR, add Next.js when SEO needed.

tickets.title: Build WelcomeScreen page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch welcome_screen to React. Static content only. No auth check. Include hero section, CTA buttons, footer. Use Tailwind for styling. Match pixel-perfect design.

tickets.title: Build Login page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch masuk screen to React. Form with email/password fields. Use react-hook-form for validation. Submit to /api/auth/login. Store JWT in httpOnly cookie. Redirect to /beranda on success. Show error on fail.
acceptance_criteria: Form validation work (email format, password min 6 chars)

tickets.title: Build Register page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch daftar_akun screen to React. Form with name, email, password, phone. Use react-hook-form. Submit to /api/auth/register. Redirect to /masuk on success. Show error on fail.
acceptance_criteria: Form validation work (email, password, phone format)

tickets.title: Build Home page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch beranda_home screen to React. Fetch user data on mount. Show product cards, event cards, quick actions. Use Tailwind grid for layout. Match design exactly.

tickets.title: Build Product Detail page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch detail_produk screen to React. Fetch product data by ID from URL param. Show images, description, price, CTA buttons. Use react-hook-form for quantity input. Add to cart logic.
acceptance_criteria: Data fetch by ID from URL

tickets.title: Build Order List page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch daftar_pesanan_saya screen to React. Fetch user orders on mount. Show order cards with status, date, amount. Filter by status. Link to order detail.

tickets.title: Build Order Detail page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch detail_pesanan_transaction_detail screen to React. Fetch order data by ID from URL. Show items, payment proof upload, cancellation request button. Use react-hook-form for file upload. Submit to /api/orders/:id/upload-proof.
acceptance_criteria: Data fetch by ID from URL

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create main App.jsx. Set up React Router v6. Routes for all pages. Auth-protected routes. Navigation bar with user menu. 404 page. Global styles. Error boundary. Ponytail: no lazy loading, add when bundle > 200KB.
